context: A teacher and a teen plan a club outdoor trip
purpose: Teach: 国旗/比例/水平/部員/滝/ボート/高まる/翼

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今度の部員旅行だけど、山奥の滝を見に行く案はどうかしら。
lines.en: About the upcoming club trip, how about going to see the waterfall deep in the mountains?
lines.style: Warm teacherly tone, gentle proposal with rising curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいですね！滝のそばの湖でボートにも乗れるって聞きました！
lines.en: Sounds great! I heard you can ride boats on the lake near the waterfall too!
lines.style: Bright teen enthusiasm, slightly hurried excited delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ボートね。水平に保つのが意外と難しいから、最初は先生も一緒に乗るわよ。
lines.en: Boats, huh. Keeping them level is surprisingly hard, so I'll ride with you at first.
lines.style: Measured caution, teacher slipping into responsible-adult mode.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やったあ！みんなの期待がどんどん高まる感じです、先生！
lines.en: Yay! Everyone's excitement just keeps rising, sensei!
lines.style: Earnest teen sincerity, voice climbing with determination.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 予算は人数に比例して増えるから、参加する部員を早めに確定しましょう。
lines.en: The budget grows in proportion to the number of people, so let's finalize the club members joining early.
lines.style: Practical teacher logistics, calm but firm planning voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 集合場所は、入口に国旗が並んでる市民公園でどうですか？分かりやすいし。
lines.en: How about the civic park where the national flags line the entrance? It's easy to find.
lines.style: Helpful teen suggestion, casual but thoughtful pitch.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいわね。あなた、まるで翼が生えたみたいに毎日張り切ってるわね。
lines.en: Nice. You're so energetic every day, like you've grown wings.
lines.style: Affectionate teacher pride, soft warmth in closing remark.
